summary: `validateBudget` accepts thresholds with no `contextWindow`, so a declared threshold can never fire and the chain that declared it is never told

tests: a budget declaring thresholds and no context window refuses where the chain declared it
notes: Verified this tick: `validateBudget({ thresholds: [0.7] })` returns clean, and `budgetLineDue` then answers false at every fraction (`src/budgetHook.ts:235`) because a crossing reads `contextFraction`, which `src/budgetLine.ts:174` leaves absent with no window. The dependency is prose today (`src/budgetHook.ts:56`-`:58`) while the validator is its declared home (`:76`-`:82`).
